content.short: Dollar/euro account product with card and global access.
content.description: Littio is a Colombian stablecoin neobank, backed by Y Combinator, that gives Latin Americans access to US dollar and euro accounts along with dollar-denominated yield. Users get real USD accounts with US ACH details and European IBANs, a Mastercard for spending, and interest-bearing 'Pots' whose returns are backed by US Treasuries and real-world assets via OpenTrade. Under the hood, Littio uses the USDC and EURC stablecoins on networks such as Avalanche and Ethereum for settlement and storage, while integrating with local banks so users in Colombia, Mexico, and Argentina can top up and withdraw in their home currencies. By wrapping stablecoin infrastructure in a familiar account-and-card experience, Littio lets people save in hard currency and earn yield despite local inflation.
content.meta: Littio is a stablecoin neobank giving LatAm users USD/EUR accounts and dollar yield. Discover Littio and other Neobanks on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
